meta.name: agent-sort
meta.description: Build an evidence-backed ECC install plan for a specific repo by sorting skills, commands, rules, hooks, and extras into DAILY vs LIBRARY buckets using parallel repo-aware review passes. Use when ECC should be trimmed to what a project actually needs instead of loading the full bundle.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按项目实际需要筛选技能和配置，精简ECC安装计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望只加载项目真正需要的技能和配置，而不是整个ECC包
copy.tagline_en: Sort skills and configs by project needs to trim ECC install plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to load only what your project actually needs instead of the full ECC bundle

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据当前仓库的实际代码（如文件类型、框架、依赖）自动分析 ECC 技能、命令、规则等组件，将它们分为“每日必用”和“备用库”两类，并生成一份安装计划。
howto.when: 当你需要为一个项目定制 ECC 安装，而不是加载全部默认技能时触发。例如项目只需要 ECC 子集、或现有配置已过时。

say.text: 为这个仓库生成 ECC 安装计划
检查这个仓库的 ECC 配置是否合适
say.note: Claude 会验证现有安装是否匹配仓库实际栈。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the current repo's actual code (file types, frameworks, dependencies) to classify ECC components into 'DAILY' (always loaded) and 'LIBRARY' (searchable) buckets, then produces an install plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a project-specific ECC install instead of the full default bundle, e.g., the project only needs a subset or the current config is stale.

say_en.text: Generate an ECC install plan for this repo.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the repo and outputs DAILY and LIBRARY classifications.

say_en.text: Check if this repo's ECC config is appropriate.
say_en.note: Claude verifies the current install matches the actual repo stack.
